description.value: Cannery Café is a casual diner situated in the historic Steveston Village waterfront district of Richmond, serving breakfast, lunch, and dinner. The café is locally notable for having served as the filming location of Granny's Diner for ABC's Once Upon a Time and Once Upon a Time in Wonderland. Outdoor seating is available, positioning it as a natural rest stop along the scenic Steveston waterfront cycling corridor.

bike_parking_detail: 4 racks within 100m: stands (5 spaces) at 32m; rack at 40m; rack at 59m; rack at 83m. Total: 5 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms Cannery Café is a real, operating casual diner in Steveston Village offering breakfast, lunch, and dinner, with no indication of closure. No cyclist-specific amenities are mentioned on the website or in OSM tags, so all required criteria and optional amenities default to null.

Opening hours discrepancy: OSM lists Mo-Fr 09:00-15:00; Sa-Su 09:00-16:00, but website shows Mon-Thu 9am-5pm, Tuesday closed, Fri-Sun 9am-9pm. OSM hours may be outdated.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, operating casual diner in Steveston Village with an active website and confirmed contact details. A natural stop for cyclists riding the Steveston waterfront area.
